messages:
sarah: FYI getting paged for high latency on chat/completions route. p95 spiking, customers noticing. incident-bot: ALERT: latency_p99 /v1/chat/completions > 3s for 3m :warning:

matt: seeing this too, started ~06:12 UTC. Looks concentrated on redwood-13b and mistral-7b groups.

raj: are we seeing increased tokens per request or just slower GPU tails?

emily: logs show steady tokens, KV cache hit rate dropped for a subset of nodes (cache-misses up ~18%). Might be a recent kvcache rollout.

katie: tagging @sarah @matt — can we flip fallback to the smaller quantized variant while we triage? 

sarah: yes. proposal: temporary routing rule: route traffic from redwood-13b -> redwood-13b-quant for 20% incoming traffic, and raise squelch so only p99 triggers pager for 10m. Thoughts? :eyes:

matt: agree on fallback. For alerting, current p95 alert fires too often during noisy infra. propose setting p95 alert to 1.2s and p99 to 2.5s for per-route thresholds, but add per-model gating (redwood-13b p95=1.5s p99=3.0s, mistral-7b p95=1.0s p99=2.0s).

raj: prefer making the alerts route-scoped (/v1/chat/completions: redwood-13b group) rather than global. Also add a 3m grace window to avoid immediate duplicates.

emily: creating a quick dashboard now to visualize per-model p95/p99 and kvcache hit rate. will post link shortly.

incident-bot: DEPLOY: rolled redwood-13b -> redwood-13b-quant split 20% at 06:21 UTC by matt

matt: split applied. monitoring for errors and latency. so far no errors.

katie: updated runbook note: temporary squelch to p99 only for 10m while we assess. adding entry under "mid-incident mitigations".

sarah: customer-impact check — product telemetry shows 0.8% of requests got >5s; top customer IDs A123, B456. reaching out via account reps to let them know we have mitigation in place.

emily: dashboard link: https://grafana.internal/r/redwood/latency-midincident?panel=per_model_p99 (shared). shows kvcache misses spike correlated with p99 increase.

raj: can we rollback the kvcache rollout to affected region? That seems likely root cause.

matt: yes we can. but rollback will cause cache warmup pain. alternative: patch kvcache config to increase local cache TTL by +30s to avoid misses. I'll open a CL.

sarah: agreed — do TTL bump first. matt, can you also schedule an alert rule change PR after the incident: make p95 alerts per-route with noise-gating and add a dashboard-derived anomaly threshold?

matt: will do. action items: 1) matt patch TTL + deploy (in progress). 2) emily save and snapshot new dashboard and add to runbook. 3) raj coordinate rollback plan if TTL patch fails. 4) katie draft customer comms for A123/B456. 5) update alerting PR postmortem.

incident-bot: NOTE: on-call handoff in 45m — sarah to pass to matt if still ongoing.

sarah: SG. if mitigations look stable we'll close the pager and open a followup thread for alert tuning and dashboard rollout. thanks everyone :thumbsup:

matt: TTL patch rolled at 06:34 UTC. preliminary metrics show kvcache miss rate dropping and p95 recovering. I'll keep monitoring; will start the alerting PR after stable window (30m).

emily: saving dashboard and adding a new panel for per-route noise gating controls. PR to infra dashboards will be up in ~1h.

sarah: closing pager in 20m if p99 stays under 2.5s. will file incident and link playbook changes.

katie: filing incident ticket with customer impact and proposed alert thresholds: per-route p95=1.2s p99=2.5s, per-model overrides noted. assigning to matt for alert PR.

matt: thanks. followup doc should include recommended squelch params: noise_gate=3m, mute_window=10m for transient spikes, per-route overrides.

sarah: great. ending live thread to reduce noise. followups on incidents/board. :white_check_mark:
